items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I had some of the Basie-ites and you know, like Earl and Dickey and Bub and I think I had Jo Jones.

ctx.x: "Swinging Like Tate." I think that would be about the best one. On the other side, I had some of the Basie-ites and you know, like Earl and Dickey and Bub and I think I had Jo Jones. Jo didn't play too good that day, though. And let me see, what else?
Was Jo very consistent during the years with Basie?
